title: MPEG: Handle zero stuffing before start codes
description:
The wiretap MPEG file format decoder handles MPEG Program Streams,
MPEG Video bitstreams, and MPEG Audio bitstreams. (Program streams
can contain the two bitstreams at a different hierarchical level.)

The former two consist of PES packets that begin with start codes,
while the audio files consist of MPEG audio frames (plus possibly
ID3 tags), and the two types are not mixed. (Program streams can
contain audio bitstreams at a different hierarchical level, but
that doesn't affect the PES packet framing.)

Remember which type of file we opened based on the magic number that
matched. Use that when reading so we can detect zero byte stuffing
that sometimes occurs before the next start code in Program Streams
or Video bitstreams and skip it.
